answer: What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the knoll until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quartz of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
